sents.zh: 草地上的风一年到头都很大。
sents.en: The wind on the grassland is strong all year.

sents.zh: 风吹过来的时候，草都动了起来。
sents.en: When it comes, all the grass moves.
From far off it looks like water.

sents.zh: 住在这里的孩子很小就学骑马。
sents.en: Children who live here learn to ride very young.

sents.zh: 三四岁的时候，就有自己的马了。
sents.en: By three or four they have a horse of their own.

sents.zh: 他们骑得很快，一点也不慢。
sents.en: They ride fast, not slowly at all.

sents.zh: 早上，他们跟着大人一起出去。
sents.en: In the morning they go out with the grown-ups.

sents.zh: 他们看着牛和马，一看就是一天。
sents.en: They watch the cattle and horses, all day long.
Only in the evening do they come back.

sents.zh: 晚上的天很黑，可是上面很亮。
sents.en: The night is dark, but the sky above is bright.

sents.zh: 因为城里的光很多，所以在城里看不到这样的天。
sents.en: Because there are so many lights in a city, you cannot see a sky like that there.

sents.zh: 他们在外面唱歌，声音传得很远。
sents.en: They sing outside, and the sound carries far.

sents.zh: 虽然这里的日子不容易，但是他们很喜欢。
sents.en: Although life here is not easy, they love it.

sents.zh: 他们说：“这是我们的地方。”
